subtasks.details:
- Use orchestrator scripts from Task 4; run against sandbox datasets
- Verify AD enforcement, provenance capture, and confidence scoring outputs
- Produce HTML/JSON reports summarizing workflow outcomes and timing
- Tag failing scenarios with actionable diagnostics

subtasks.title: Execute load and batch testing
subtasks.description: Simulate multi-chemical batches at 10x scale and capture performance benchmarks for transport, predictive services, and orchestrator.
subtasks.details:
- Build load test scripts using Locust/k6 hitting transport and micro-servers
- Model realistic call mixes and concurrency levels
- Record latency, error rates, and resource utilization metrics
- Provide tuning recommendations and thresholds for production sign-off

subtasks.title: Wire CI/CD and nightly automation
subtasks.description: Integrate workflow harness into CI pipelines, schedule nightly sandbox runs, and publish test reports.
subtasks.details:
- Add GitHub Actions (or equivalent) workflows for PR and nightly jobs
- Handle credential management and sandbox fallback toggles
- Publish artifacts (JUnit, coverage, performance dashboards) to shared storage
- Alert on regressions with clear ownership and triage docs

tasks.title: Implement observability and governance controls
tasks.description: Capture telemetry, enforce policy hooks, and publish operational runbooks for Phase 2.
tasks.details:
- Persist request IDs, rate-limit metrics, and workflow audit trails to durable storage
- Add configurable policy engine hooks (block predictions without AD pass, enforce consent on high-risk endpoints)
- Produce runbooks covering failure recovery, credential rotation, and incident response
- Align logging and retention policies with regulatory requirements
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests cover policy toggles; integration tests verify audit logging and retention settings in representative workflows.

subtasks.title: Define observability and governance requirements
subtasks.description: Document telemetry, audit, and policy needs for transport, metadata, predictive, and orchestrator services.
subtasks.details:
- Identify mandatory metrics, traces, and logs per stakeholder requirements
- Map data retention, access controls, and compliance constraints
- Prioritize policy hooks (e.g., AD enforcement, consent flags, rate limits)
- Produce requirements doc for implementation teams

subtasks.title: Implement telemetry collection
subtasks.description: Instrument transport, micro-servers, and orchestrator with structured logging, metrics, and tracing.
subtasks.details:
- Add request/response logging with correlation IDs across services
- Export metrics (latency, error rate, AD failure counts) to Prometheus-compatible endpoint
- Integrate distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry) spanning transport and micro-servers
- Provide dashboards and alerts for key SLOs

subtasks.title: Build audit logging and retention pipeline
subtasks.description: Persist workflow audit trails, provenance bundles, and policy decisions with retention and access controls.
subtasks.details:
- Design storage schema (e.g., object store + index) for audit bundles and metadata
- Implement write path from orchestrator and micro-servers with integrity checks
- Configure retention schedules, encryption, and access control lists
- Provide retrieval APIs and compliance reporting scripts

subtasks.title: Implement policy engine hooks
subtasks.description: Create configurable policy layer to enforce AD pass, consent requirements, and risk flags across services.
subtasks.details:
- Define policy configuration model with priority/order controls
- Wire enforcement points in transport, predictive micro-servers, and orchestrator
- Support real-time overrides and audit logging of policy decisions
- Add unit/integration tests covering allow, block, and warn flows

subtasks.title: Publish operational runbooks
subtasks.description: Document deployment, monitoring, incident response, credential rotation, and recovery procedures.
subtasks.details:
- Create runbooks covering normal ops, failovers, AD policy updates, and audit requests
- Include dashboard links, alert thresholds, and contact escalation matrix
- Provide credential rotation checklist and sandbox credential handling guidance
- Store runbooks in `docs/operations/` with version control

subtasks.title: Coordinate governance review and sign-off
subtasks.description: Engage SMEs and Regulatory Affairs to review telemetry, policy hooks, and audit controls before release.
subtasks.details:
- Schedule review sessions with Computational Toxicology, Platform, and Regulatory stakeholders
- Capture feedback and track remediation tasks
- Obtain documented approval for model card publication and policy settings
- Archive sign-off artifacts alongside release notes

tasks.title: Refresh documentation and developer experience
tasks.description: Update docs and SDK guidance to reflect MCP Phase 2 architecture, workflows, and guardrails.
tasks.details:
- Revise README and docs/ content with Phase 2 transport architecture, workflow diagrams, and guardrail policies
- Publish sample Agentic SDK integration scripts and QA checklists for onboarding
- Capture model card publication workflow and governance sign-off process
- Ensure machine-readable docs and policies stay versioned alongside releases
tasks.testStrategy: Doc review checklist signed by platform, SME, and DX stakeholders; sample agent scripts run successfully using documented steps.

subtasks.title: Outline documentation content plan
subtasks.description: Inventory doc updates required across README, docs/, and SDK guides for Phase 2.
subtasks.details:
- Identify architecture sections, workflow diagrams, policy docs, and runbooks to update
- Map owners/reviewers for each doc deliverable
- Create documentation timeline aligned with release milestones
- Track open questions requiring stakeholder input

subtasks.title: Update architecture documentation
subtasks.description: Refresh README and docs/ architecture sections with Phase 2 transport, metadata, and orchestration design.
subtasks.details:
- Create diagrams for MCP transport, micro-servers, and orchestrator interactions
- Document guardrails, AD enforcement, and audit flows
- Highlight success metrics and testing strategy for stakeholders
- Ensure docs reference machine-readable schemas and sample configs

subtasks.title: Document model cards and guardrail policies
subtasks.description: Publish human-readable summaries of model metadata, AD rules, and policy configurations.
subtasks.details:
- Generate Markdown/HTML views from JSON model cards with key highlights
- Explain AD checks, failure modes, and remediation steps for agents
- Outline policy engine defaults and examples for customization
- Include review/sign-off workflow references for governance

subtasks.title: Create Agentic SDK integration samples
subtasks.description: Provide sample scripts and notebooks demonstrating Phase 2 MCP transport and workflows for developers.
subtasks.details:
- Build Python/TypeScript examples calling handshake, discovery, and orchestrated workflows
- Include AD failure handling and audit bundle retrieval patterns
- Add quickstart guides and dependency setup instructions
- Validate samples against latest services and include automated smoke tests

subtasks.title: Publish QA and onboarding checklists
subtasks.description: Create checklists for QA, SMEs, and new developers covering setup, testing, and review workflows.
subtasks.details:
- Summarize prerequisite accounts, credentials, and environment variables
- Provide step-by-step verification for transport, metadata, and orchestrator flows
- Include AD and policy validation steps and expected responses
- Store checklists in `docs/qa/` with version history

subtasks.title: Automate documentation publishing
subtasks.description: Set up tooling to build, lint, and publish updated docs and samples alongside releases.
subtasks.details:
- Configure MkDocs/Sphinx (or equivalent) build pipeline with CI integration
- Add doc linting and broken link detection
- Publish versioned docs to internal portal or repo pages
- Coordinate release notes summarizing Phase 2 changes

tasks.title: Add HTTP MCP endpoint for agent compatibility
tasks.description: Introduce a JSON-RPC over HTTP transport similar to the O-QT server so Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and other standard MCP clients can connect without the Phase 2 WebSocket path.

subtasks.title: Map O-QT router patterns to EPAComp architecture
subtasks.description: Review `O-QT_MCP/o-qt-mcp-server/src/mcp/router.py` and define how JSON-RPC request parsing, error handling, and method dispatch should call into the existing `MCPServer` components.

subtasks.title: Implement `/mcp` FastAPI endpoint backed by MCPServer
subtasks.description: Add a FastAPI router that mirrors the O-QT JSON-RPC flow, reusing `MCPServer.list_tools`, `call_tool`, and new initialization helpers to respond to `initialize`, `tools.list`, `tools.call`, etc.

subtasks.title: Add HTTP MCP conformance tests
subtasks.description: Create unit/integration tests that exercise `initialize`, `tools.list`, `tools.call`, permission errors, and notification handling over HTTP to match the WebSocket coverage.

tasks.title: Introduce centralized MCP tool registry
tasks.description: Refactor tool definitions to use a registry with Pydantic schemas and role checks so HTTP and WebSocket transports share uniform tool metadata.

subtasks.title: Draft registry interface and RBAC strategy
subtasks.description: Sketch the tool registry API, schema generation rules, and role-based checks taking cues from `src/tools/registry.py` in the O-QT repo.

subtasks.title: Create Pydantic parameter/output models per tool
subtasks.description: Implement dataclasses or Pydantic models for each resource tool so the registry can emit consistent `inputSchema` and optional `outputSchema` blocks.

subtasks.title: Wire registry into HTTP and WebSocket transports
subtasks.description: Replace direct resource traversal with registry lookups in both transports, ensuring permission checks and schema metadata flow through the shared layer.

tasks.title: Modernize configuration and settings management
tasks.description: Adopt a pydantic-settings based configuration layer with `.env` support, mirroring the O-QT project layout for auth, CTX API, and observability toggles.

subtasks.title: Design settings module hierarchy
subtasks.description: Create `epacomp_tox.config.settings` with typed sections for app, security, CTX API, transport, and observability values using `pydantic-settings`.

subtasks.title: Generate `.env.example` and migrate env usage
subtasks.description: Document all new settings in `.env.example`, update Docker/entrypoint scripts, and remove legacy `get_api_key` helpers that duplicate the new settings.

subtasks.title: Refactor service startup to consume new settings
subtasks.description: Update both transports, orchestrator utilities, and tests to load configuration via the settings module, adjusting dependency injection where required.

tasks.title: Rewrite README and integration docs
tasks.description: Adopt the O-QT README structure, align messaging, and add a dedicated MCP integration guide covering Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and Claude.

subtasks.title: Draft updated README outline
subtasks.description: Map the O-QT README sections to EPAComp content, identifying what needs to be rewritten (quick start, config table, tool catalog, security, roadmap).

subtasks.title: Update README content and assets
subtasks.description: Rewrite the README with the new structure, update badges/links, add configuration tables, and ensure quick start commands match the modernized setup.

subtasks.title: Write MCP integration guide for popular agents
subtasks.description: Create `docs/integration_guides/mcp_integration.md` with configuration snippets for Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and Claude, plus troubleshooting tips for auth and binary payloads.

tasks.title: Clean up packaging and dependency management
tasks.description: Move to a modern `pyproject.toml` layout with tool configuration, dependency pins, and remove legacy setup scripts in line with the O-QT project.

subtasks.title: Author consolidated pyproject.toml
subtasks.description: Define project metadata, core dependencies, optional dev extras, and tool configs (black, isort, pytest) inspired by O-QT’s pyproject.

subtasks.title: Retire legacy setup.py and adjust build scripts
subtasks.description: Migrate CI, Dockerfile, and developer docs to use the new build backend and remove redundant packaging files.

subtasks.title: Standardize dependency pins and lock workflow
subtasks.description: Review dependency versions vs. O-QT, set compatible ranges, and document how to generate/update lock files for reproducible installs.

tasks.title: Align security and observability middleware
tasks.description: Bring over CORS, security headers, audit logging, and consistent health/metrics endpoints modeled after the O-QT server.

subtasks.title: Implement configurable CORS and security headers
subtasks.description: Port the middleware pattern from O-QT to expose environment-driven origin lists and security headers across HTTP and WebSocket routes.

subtasks.title: Add structured audit logging hooks
subtasks.description: Introduce audit events for HTTP and WebSocket tool executions, persisting correlation IDs and status fields for downstream compliance logging.

subtasks.title: Unify health, readiness, and metrics endpoints
subtasks.description: Ensure both transports share `/health`, `/readyz`, and `/metrics` responses with consistent payloads and document observability expectations.

tasks.title: Expand automated testing and smoke coverage
tasks.description: Add HTTP transport tests, cross-transport regression cases, and CLI smoke scripts modeled after O-QT to validate end-to-end compatibility.

subtasks.title: Implement pytest coverage for HTTP transport
subtasks.description: Mirror existing WebSocket conformance tests to hit the new `/mcp` endpoint, covering happy path, errors, and cancellation behavior.

subtasks.title: Add agent smoke scripts
subtasks.description: Provide CLI scripts or docs to exercise Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and Claude against local deployments, verifying binary artifact handling.

subtasks.title: Document regression test matrix
subtasks.description: Update testing docs to include cross-transport expectations, agent compatibility checks, and how to run the new suites in CI.

metadata.description: Align EPA CompTox MCP with O-QT baseline for multi-agent compatibility
